name: Lightning gloves
description: Lightning gloves were a rare type of glove in use during the Dark Wars, a series of conflicts fought between the remnants of the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. The gloves produced strong electrical pulses when they came in contact with another object, a property which provided the user an advantage in unarmed combat.

data.name: Lightning gloves
purpose: Delivering damaging electrical pulses in unarmed combat
